Overall Description of the Community:
Welcome to Traditions at Carolina Forest

Traditions at Carolina Forest is a single-family home community located in the heart of Myrtle Beach, SC, within the highly sought-after Carolina Forest area. Designed for comfort, connection, and everyday convenience, this community offers a welcoming place to call home—no matter where you are in your homebuying journey.

Blending modern living with classic Southern charm, Traditions provides easy access to everything that makes coastal life so appealing. Residents are just minutes from Myrtle Beach’s beautiful beaches, championship golf courses, popular shopping destinations, local restaurants, and weekend festivals and entertainment. With excellent schools and top-rated medical centers nearby, Traditions at Carolina Forest is ideal for living, working, and enjoying life at every stage.

Community Amenities Designed for Every Lifestyle

Traditions at Carolina Forest offers a mix of amenities that support both active living and laid-back relaxation. Whether you're ready to settle in now or planning for the future, the community provides space to connect, recharge, and enjoy life.

Residents can gather at the beautifully designed clubhouse, featuring stylish indoor spaces perfect for social events, celebrations, or casual get-togethers. The attached fitness center includes modern cardio and strength-training equipment, making it easy to stay active without leaving the neighborhood.

On warm Carolina days, the sparkling community pool offers a refreshing escape with comfortable loungers and shaded areas for relaxing poolside. Families will appreciate the community playground, a safe and engaging space where children can play, explore, and make new friends close to home.

Pet owners will love the dedicated dog park, complete with open space and separate areas for small and large dogs, creating a welcoming environment for both pets and their people. Pickleball courts add another layer of fun and connection, offering opportunities for friendly competition, fitness, and social interaction for all skill levels.

A Connected Community in Carolina Forest

With its central location, everyday amenities, and flexible home options, Traditions at Carolina Forest offers a community designed to fit every stage of life. Whether you’re building, buying, or simply exploring what’s next, Traditions provides the space, comfort, and lifestyle you’ve been looking for.

Welcome to Goose Marsh

Welcome to

Goose Marsh

, a new Chesapeake Homes community in

Brunswick County, North Carolina

, where coastal charm meets peaceful living. This thoughtfully designed neighborhood offers a beautiful selection of

new single-family homes

with spacious layouts, modern features, and the quality craftsmanship Chesapeake Homes is known for. Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer, growing family, or empty nester looking for a fresh start, Goose Marsh provides a perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and coastal lifestyle.

New Homes in Brunswick County, NC

Located in one of the most desirable areas of

Coastal North Carolina

, Goose Marsh places you close to everything you love about the coast. Enjoy a quiet, serene setting just a short drive from

Holden Beach, Ocean Isle Beach, and Shallotte

, where you can spend your days soaking up the sun, exploring local shops, or savoring fresh seafood along the waterfront. The community’s location also offers easy access to

Novant Health Brunswick Medical Center

, making everyday living both relaxed and worry-free.

Brunswick County continues to attract homebuyers for its affordable cost of living and unbeatable natural beauty. Here you can experience a true sense of community.

Brunswick Nature Park

, walking the scenic trails at

Oak Island

, or taking a ferry to

Bald Head Island

to visit the historic

Old Baldy Lighthouse.

Golf lovers can tee off at one of over 30 golf courses throughout Brunswick County, each offering lush fairways and breathtaking coastal views.

When you’re ready for a night out, take a short drive to

Southport

, a charming coastal town filled with boutique shops, art galleries, and restaurants overlooking the water. From sunset cruises to pier fishing, there’s always something new to discover in this picturesque part of North Carolina. And for an unforgettable dining experience, head to nearby

Calabash

, known as the “Seafood Capital of the World,” where you can enjoy authentic, freshly caught Calabash-style seafood right where it originated.

Discover the Chesapeake Homes Difference

At Goose Marsh, you’ll experience what it truly means to live the

coastal Carolina lifestyle

—where peaceful surroundings, friendly neighbors, and convenient access to beaches and nature come together. Discover the beauty of

new construction homes in Brunswick County

and find out why so many buyers are choosing to call Goose Marsh home.

Plan Description: Welcome to The Azalea model! This open-concept plan allows for natural lighting to fill the 3,016 square feet of space it offers. This personal sanctuary has plenty of space with two walk-in closets, a sitting area, and an extensive spa-inspired deluxe bathroom. But before you end the night in your beautiful home, spend the evening on your rear covered porch. This home has enough space for everyone to have their personalized area.
